counterfactual_missing_items: distinctive clinical features of Hobnail hemangioma
histopathological differences between Dabska tumor and Hobnail hemangioma
decisive_items: hyaline globules in the cytoplasm of endothelial cells
ectatic thin-walled vessels with multiple intravascular branching papillary structures
response.rationale: The presence of intravascular branching papillary structures and hyaline globules in endothelial cells is more characteristic of Dabska tumor, although both candidates share some similar features.

rejected.why: lacks distinct diagnostic features and is an append-only completion of R1
